title: GateApiError
description: Error body returned by the gate endpoints. The code identifies the error. The message is text for people and does not include payload bodies, nonces or signatures. Statuses: not_found 404, already_decided 409, verification_failed 403, invalid_request 400 (413 over 1 MiB, 422 for an edited intent the schemas or the original's kind refuse), unauthenticated 401 (no valid session cookie on a gated phone route), misdirected_request 421 (a Host header the listener does not serve), unsupported_media_type 415 (a phone-listener POST whose Content-Type is not application/json), tier_changed 409 and forbidden 403 (an edit refused by policy), unavailable 500.
